# Best Man Backup

> Best Man Backup is an independent site for best men only. It publishes free practical guides on the speech, the duties and the stag do or bachelor party, and it sells digital preparation kits on Etsy. Guides are in UK English, with notes where US weddings differ. The kits are editable downloads, not a speech-writing service.

Site: https://bestmanbackup.com/
Guides: https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/

## Writing the speech
- [how to write a best man speech](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/how-to-write-a-best-man-speech/): How to collect stories, structure a speech, cut it to time and rehearse.
- [best man speech examples](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/best-man-speech-examples/): Four original speeches, funny, heartfelt, short and from a newer friend, with notes.
- [funny best man speech](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/funny-best-man-speech/): How to build laughs into a whole speech, with one full original example.
- [best man speech opening lines](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/best-man-speech-opening-lines/): How to start, with opening lines in several styles and what to avoid.
- [3 prompts to start your best man speech](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/3-prompts-to-start-your-best-man-speech/): Three writing prompts: how you met, one story, and a toast-first closer.
- [best man speech jokes](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/best-man-speech-jokes/): Safe one-liners for a mixed room, and a check for each joke.
- [best man speech template](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/best-man-speech-template/): An eight-part fill-in structure with word counts and a worked example.
- [what not to say in a best man speech](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/what-not-to-say-in-a-best-man-speech/): Exes, stag stories, in-jokes and other lines that backfire, and what to say instead.
- [how long should a best man speech be](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/how-long-should-a-best-man-speech-be/): Most speeches land at 3–5 minutes; 5–7 if you are the main UK speaker; never over 10.
- [short best man speech](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/short-best-man-speech/): Complete examples at about 60 seconds, 2 minutes and 3 minutes.
- [how to end a best man speech](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/how-to-end-a-best-man-speech/): Twenty closing lines and a word-for-word last 30 seconds, then the toast.
- [best man toast](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/best-man-toast/): Short, funny and formal toast examples, and the difference between a UK speech and a US toast.
- [joint best man speech](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/joint-best-man-speech/): How two best men split one speech, with a full two-voice example and staging.
- [best woman speech](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/best-woman-speech/): The same job under a different title: structure, lines and the toast.
- [best man speech for a brother](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/best-man-speech-for-a-brother/): Which family stories work, and how to welcome a partner.
- [best man speech for a best friend](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/best-man-speech-for-a-best-friend/): Childhood friends and friends you met later, including when you do not know the partner well.
- [wedding speech order](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/wedding-speech-order/): Who speaks when in the UK and the US, and how long each speech runs.
- [rehearsal dinner toast](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/rehearsal-dinner-toast/): What a US rehearsal dinner toast is, and three short original examples.

## Giving the speech
- [best man speech nerves](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/best-man-speech-nerves/): How to practise, what to do on the day, and how to recover if you lose your place.

## Duties and the wedding day
- [best mans job](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/best-mans-job/): The job in plain English: what is yours, and what is not.
- [best man duties checklist](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/best-man-duties-checklist/): The checklist for before, during and after the wedding.
- [best man duties timeline](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/best-man-duties-timeline/): What to do month by month, plus a short-notice version.
- [best man vs groomsmen vs ushers](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/best-man-vs-groomsmen-vs-ushers/): Who does the stag do, the rings, the guests and the speech.
- [what does the best man do on the wedding day](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/what-does-the-best-man-do-on-the-wedding-day/): The day itself, from getting him ready to the last dance.
- [what does the best man pay for](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/what-does-the-best-man-pay-for/): Suits in the UK and the US, the stag do, travel and gifts.

## The stag do
- [how to plan a stag do](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/how-to-plan-a-stag-do/): Agree it with the groom, set a budget, book in order and collect the money.
- [stag do budget](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/stag-do-budget/): How to set a per-head budget and cover the groom's share fairly.
- [stag do games](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/stag-do-games/): Twelve games that work with or without a drink, plus a printable round sheet.
- [non drinking stag do ideas](https://bestmanbackup.com/guides/non-drinking-stag-do-ideas/): Fifteen day, evening and weekend plans, including mixed groups.
